# Rapier

> The document editor an agent hands a person and works in beside them: one offline page, exact source, every change the person's to keep or drop.

- [Agent guide](agents.md): read, edit, propose, compare, undo and draw; hand a person the editor with their document inside (`npx rapier-html notes.md`).
- Draw a person a diagram: `document.draw` takes named boxes and arrows (no coordinates) and lays out a flowchart, a process or an architecture in Rapier's own look, numbered steps and captions, light and dark, every box still editable. Supported Mermaid flowchart fences also draw offline in Rapier's look, so an agent can write a fence or use figures.
- Close the page loop: `document.create_return` gives `rapier-html --return` a one-use address. The person edits offline and presses Send back; `document.wait_for_user` receives the receipt and `document.read_context` reads the returned copy without replacing the workspace's current work.
- [Tool catalog](AGENT-TOOLS.json): schemas and effects.
- [Self-contained Markdown](markdown-standard.md): the open convention on CommonMark that carries pictures, layout and colour in one .md file.
- [Will/1](will.md): optional; what an agent may edit, only append to, or keep.
- [Build receipt](BUILD.json): this build's identity and checked scope.
